features.name: Darkvision
features.detail: See in dim light within 60 ft as if bright, darkness as if dim

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.detail: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead

features.name: Savage Attacks
features.detail: On a melee weapon crit, roll one extra weapon damage die

features.name: Rage
features.detail: Bonus action: +2 melee damage, advantage on STR checks/saves, resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing; lasts 1 minute

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.detail: No armor: AC = 10 + DEX mod + CON mod

inventory.item: A wolf-fang necklace, one fang for every beast that tested her

traits: Speaks in growls and short sentences; the only thing that makes her smile is a worthy fight.
ideals: Respect is taken, not asked for — and anything that threatens her pack answers to her.
bonds: Her mountain clan sent her out to find what the thunder on the horizon means; she won't return without an answer.
flaws: Believes every problem has a wall she can break through it — sometimes there isn't a wall.
